heading: No cascade
text:
### No cascade [LNOG.4.3]

Because no logical facts are asserted, there is no TMS cascade.  A
retraction event propagates through the beta network (ridx-based) to
retract joined tokens, but it does not cause further WM retractions
beyond those directly joined to the retracted WM fact.

The absence of cascade eliminates:
- Re-entrancy constraints on TMS withdrawal.
- The `local_ids[DS_TMS_INLINE]` stack copy in `terminal_left_retract`.
- The `caller_must_free` path.
- Any need to bound cascade depth in T_wcet.
